thought_title: Honor deacons, bishop and presbyters, for without them nothing is called a church

edition.witness_note: Lake 1912 Loeb copy-text; Lightfoot/Funk middle recension not yet locked as second witness

source_text: [1] Ὁμοίως πάντες ἐντρεπέσθωσαν τοὺς διακόνους ὡς Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν, ὡς καὶ τὸν ἐπίσκοπον ὄντα τύπον τοῦ πατρός. τοὺς δὲ πρεσβυτέρους ὡς συνέδριον θεοῦ καὶ ὡς σύνδεσμον ἀποστόλων. χωρὶς τούτων ἐκκλησία οὐ καλεῖται. [2] περὶ ὧν πέπεισμαι ὑμᾶς οὕτως ἔχειν. τὸ γὰρ ἐξεμπλάριον τῆς ἀγάπης ὑμῶν ἔλαβον καὶ ἔχω μεθ̓ ἑαυτοῦ ἐν τῷ ἐπισκόπῳ ὑμῶν, οὖ αὐτὸ τὸ κατάστημα μεγάλη μαθητεία, ἡ δὲ πραότης αὐτοῦ δύναμις: ὃν λογίζομαι καὶ τοὺς ἀθέους ἐντρέπεσθαι. [3] ἀγαπῶν ὑμᾶς φείδομαι, συντονώτερον δυνάμενος γράφειν ὑπὲρ τούτου. οὐκ εἰς τοῦτο ᾠήθην, ἵνα ὤν κατάκριτος ὡς ἀπόστολος ὑμῖν διατάσσωμαι.
pass_a_gloss: In the same way let everyone respect the deacons as Jesus Christ, and so also the bishop, who is a type of the Father, and the presbyters as the council of God and as the band of the apostles. Without these, nothing is called a church. About these things I am convinced that you are so minded. For I received the sample of your love, and I have it with me in your bishop, whose very bearing is a great lesson and whose gentleness is power; I reckon that even the godless respect him. Because I love you I spare you, though I am able to write more sharply about this. I did not think myself (fit) for this, that being a condemned man I should give you orders like an apostle.
pass_b_english: Likewise, let everyone honor the deacons as Jesus Christ, and the bishop too, for he is a figure of the Father, and the presbyters as God's council and the apostles' band. Without these, nothing is called a church.

I am sure you feel the same about all this. For I have received the sample of your love, and I keep it with me in your bishop. His very bearing is a great lesson, and his gentleness is power. I think even the godless honor him.
Because I love you, I spare you, though I could write more sharply on this point. I did not think myself fit for this, that I, a condemned man, should issue you commands like an apostle.

choices.term: τοὺς διακόνους ὡς Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν, ὡς καὶ τὸν ἐπίσκοπον ὄντα τύπον τοῦ πατρός
choices.english: let everyone honor the deacons as Jesus Christ, and the bishop too, for he is a figure of the Father
choices.why: ὡς καὶ τὸν ἐπίσκοπον is a second object of the imperative ἐντρεπέσθωσαν; English keeps the bishop inside the command. Lake's text (deacons as Jesus Christ, bishop as type of the Father) is translated as printed, not harmonized to ANF.
rejected: just as they respect the bishop (turns the command into a statement)
deacons as an appointment of Jesus Christ, bishop as Jesus Christ (ANF; different text)

choices.why: τύπος = figure/pattern; 'figure' keeps representation without claiming identity or εἰκών language.
σύνδεσμος is what binds together; with ἀποστόλων it names the apostolic company.
Latin loanword exemplarium: a copy or specimen; the bishop embodies the church's love. No qualifier added.

choices.english: I did not think myself fit for this
choices.why: Text corrupt in all witnesses (Lake note); 'fit' is the minimum supplement Lake also supplies ('competent'). ὡς ἀπόστολος kept as 'like an apostle', not counterfactual.
rejected: as if I were an apostle (adds counterfactual)
reach such a height of self-esteem (ANF; different text)
nothing can be called a church (adds modality)

anf_compare.notes: ANF follows a different text: deacons 'as an appointment of Jesus Christ', bishop 'as Jesus Christ, who is the Son of the Father'; Lake has deacons as Jesus Christ and bishop as type of the Father. ANF 'pleased that I do not spare myself' has no counterpart in Lake 3.3.

notes: Lake note at 3.3: text confused and corrupt in all authorities; Lightfoot reads οὕτως φείδομαι and supplies ἀλλ' οὐχ ἱκανὸν before εἰς τοῦτο. Translation follows the printed sense.
'likewise … honor' renders Ὁμοίως … ἐντρεπέσθωσαν; 'honor' and 'respect' both fit ἐντρέπω.
Repair round 1: bishop restored as object of the imperative in Pass A; Pass B drops added 'living', 'alone', 'can be', 'as if I were', and the unprinted 'But'.

review.notes: Checked the single locked paragraph (Trallians 3.1–3). Ὁμοίως πάντες ἐντρεπέσθωσαν τοὺς διακόνους ὡς Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν, ὡς καὶ τὸν ἐπίσκοπον ὄντα τύπον τοῦ πατρός is kept as a command in Pass A ('let everyone respect the deacons as Jesus Christ, and so also the bishop, who is a type of the Father') and Pass B ('let everyone honor the deacons as Jesus Christ, and the bishop too, for he is a figure of the Father'). τοὺς δὲ πρεσβυτέρους ὡς συνέδριον θεοῦ καὶ ὡς σύνδεσμον ἀποστόλων and χωρὶς τούτων ἐκκλησία οὐ καλεῖται match 'the council of God and as the band of the apostles' / 'Without these, nothing is called a church' (indicative, not 'can'). περὶ ὧν πέπεισμαι ὑμᾶς οὕτως ἔχειν through ὃν λογίζομαι καὶ τοὺς ἀθέους ἐντρέπεσθαι is in A ('I am convinced that you are so minded... even the godless respect him') and B ('I am sure you feel the same... even the godless honor him'). ἀγαπῶν ὑμᾶς φείδομαι, συντονώτερον δυνάμενος γράφειν and οὐκ εἰς τοῦτο ᾠήθην, ἵνα ὤν κατάκριτος ὡς ἀπόστολος ὑμῖν διατάσσωμαι match the spare/able-to-write-more-sharply clause and the negated self-estimate; '(fit)'/'fit' is the disclosed supplement for the corrupt printed line, and ὡς ἀπόστολος stays 'like an apostle.' No scripture quotation appears, so no citation is missing or false. Title names the threefold-honor thought.

All clauses of the single source paragraph [1] are present in both Pass A and Pass B. Negation in οὐ καλεῖται is correctly rendered as 'nothing is called a church' (not 'can be called'). Agency: subject ὑμᾶς in περὶ ὧν πέπεισμαι ὑμᾶς is preserved as 'you are so minded' / 'you feel the same'. Modality: ἐντρεπέσθωσαν imperative is correctly rendered as imperative in both Pass A ('let everyone respect') and Pass B ('let everyone honor'). Doctrine: hierarchical structure (deacons as Christ, bishop as type of Father, presbyters as council and bond of apostles) is intact. Scripture: no inline citations present, so check passes vacuously. Title 'Honor deacons, bishop and presbyters, for without them nothing is called a church' names the thought (ecclesial order), not just locus. Notes disclose OCR corruption and editorial choices per Lake. No uncertainties remain. Covered source paragraphs: [1].
